ignoreValues.reason: Claude triage: a one-sided border on a rounded-full element is the spin arc itself, not an accent border on a card - `animate-spin rounded-full border-b-2` is the loading indicator. Scoped per file and wildcarded because border-accent-on-rounded extracts no value, so a value-scoped ignore cannot match it. The product hand-rolls this same spinner 61 times across 38 files, which is why the entry list grows one file at a time; recorded as R-064. When the spinner becomes one component these entries collapse into one.

Claude triage, sanctioned exception: the two Open Sans @font-face rules are the cPanel skin, where matching that product's face is the point, and they are split into latin / latin-ext subsets precisely so Turkish characters render without pulling the whole face.
